Author: @jamiedorsey4167
Comment:
A lot of life isn't a zero sum game where only a few can win.
We can't all be Bill Gates, but we all can improve on the starting hand we were dealt. Don't measure your success against others, someone will always be doing better. Measure it against your past self.
Luck matters, but is out of our control. The choices and efforts we make put us in positions to take advantage of whatever luck may come our way. There's a lot of luck in poker but there's a reason the same people win more than others. They avoid the situations with bad probabilities and maximize the situations with good probabilities.
As Wayne Gretzky said, "You miss %100 of the shots you don't take."
